name: preflight-bare-filename-references
title: Preflight does not validate bare-filename path references in documentation
description: The review preflight's documentation path-reference check decides eligibility by matching a reference against eight enumerated top-level filenames or 26 directory prefixes, so a bare filename such as review.py or manifest.json is never validated even when it names a tracked file. A reference of that form can rot silently: it carries no directory, so a file move leaves it looking correct. Observed on PR #339, where preflight passed with 0 failures and a paid Copilot round caught two unqualified references the deterministic gate should have. Add an eligibility rule that resolves a bare filename against the repository index without raising the false-failure rate on prose that merely contains a dot.
creator: sdelmas
